verdict.rationale: Poly is a files-and-notes workspace with a Mind notes area, so querying notes by structured properties is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no property-based queries and no live database-style views built from queries. What it does document is adjacent: natural-language search (poly-docs-2, poly-docs-6), folder view modes (poly-docs-25) and Finder tag sync (poly-docs-8), none of which provide structured-property queries rendered as tables, boards or lists.
